mapper.sql: select t.*, s.supplier_name as supplier_name, pr.request_no as request_no, c.contract_no as contract_no from erp_purchase_order t left join erp_supplier s on s.id = t.supplier_id left join erp_purchase_request pr on pr.id = t.request_id left join erp_contract c on c.id = t.contract_id
mapper.insert: insert into erp_purchase_order (order_no, request_id, supplier_id, contract_id, order_date, expected_date, total_amount, order_status, approval_comment, dept_id, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{orderNo}, #{requestId}, #{supplierId}, #{contractId}, #{orderDate}, #{expectedDate}, #{totalAmount}, #{orderStatus}, #{approvalComment}, #{deptId}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.delete: delete from erp_purchase_order where id in #{id}
